locked_core.statement: For every dimension n, every real unit-diagonal SPD A, and every x, E_pi[D_pi(x)] >= (1/16)||Ax||_2^2.
locked_core.first_bad_edge: The proposed dimension-free comparison from expected epoch dissipation to the squared initial Euclidean residual.
locked_core.dimension_minimality_reason: The universal first-position bound E D>=||Ax||^2/n proves the locked 1/16 lemma for all n<=16.
locked_core.reason_master_claim_survives: The witness residual is in a high-eigenvalue direction. The failed residual comparison is much stronger than the mu-weighted A-energy dissipation needed for a one-epoch target transfer.

sharp_route_local_replacement.statement: For every unit-diagonal SPD A and x, E_pi D_pi(x) >= ||Ax||_2^2/n, and the coefficient 1/n is asymptotically sharp over signed equicorrelation families.
sharp_route_local_replacement.target_effect: Only O(n^2/mu log(1/epsilon)) coordinate updates; insufficient for C050.
sharp_route_local_replacement.open_objection: No independent hostile audit has reconstructed the sharpness statement.

repair_candidate.name: mean-plus-random-transposition-Dirichlet proxy
repair_candidate.statement: There exists a universal c_*>0 such that ||E_pi T_pi x||_A^2+(n-1)E_{pi,pair}||T_pi x-T_pi' x||_A^2/4 <= (1-c_*mu)||x||_A^2 for every unit-diagonal SPD A and x.
repair_candidate.constant_sharpness_control: Any universal c_* must satisfy c_*<=1 because A=I has mu=1 and B_I=0. Thus the structured c_*=1 value is maximal if the general proxy is true.
repair_candidate.why_route_faithful: It uses the same uniform permutation, random position transposition, and paired endpoint trajectories frozen in the card. It does not diagonalize the covariance superoperator.
repair_candidate.target_transfer: The sharp Hilbert-valued permutation Poincare inequality upper-bounds E||T_pi x||_A^2 by the proxy. Conditional iteration and Jensen would give C050 with C=1 and exponent c_*mu/2.
repair_candidate.relation_to_C051: A proof would imply C051; C051 is neither assumed nor treated as equivalent to C050.
support: Exact rational c_*=1 controls on signed equicorrelation n=5, hub-leaf star n=5, unequal signed blocks n=4 and n=6, and an interacting signed Hadamard n=4 family.
An E3 draft proves c_*=1 for all-dimensional direct sums of signed 2x2 correlation blocks and isolated coordinates.
The alternating endpoint has an exact subset-cancellation expansion: it begins at off-diagonal order n-2 for odd n and n-1 for even n; the full symbolic n=3 formula is recorded.
The rational n=3 matrix that refutes the stronger high-mode residual comparison nevertheless passes the actual c_*=1 proxy exactly, separating the false repair from EP.

For each fixed dimension, fixed nonzero zero-diagonal perturbation H, and fixed block length m, an E3 local expansion proves c=1 for A=I+epsilon H at all sufficiently small positive epsilon; the neighborhood is not uniform.
A seed-14320260825 float64 null scan over n=3,...,7 is E1 only.
open_objections: The Poincare constant is calibrated to the slowest permutation representation; higher permutation modes may make the proxy slack cancel all mu-scale dissipation.
Equivalently, the exact Fourier surplus E D-sum_lambda[(n-1)(1-lambda)/2-1]||F_lambda||_A^2 may fail to dominate c mu||x||_A^2; the sign component has weight n-1.
The tempting stronger sign-mode comparison E D-||Alt_A x||_A^2>=||Ax||_2^2 is exactly false on the recorded rational n=3 SPD matrix, although this does not refute the mu-scale proxy.
A direct bound of a nonadjacent swap by adjacent identities can accumulate an interval-length factor and has not been closed.
All-dimensional interacting, signed, anisotropic families remain unchecked analytically.
Because the conclusion is a one-epoch energy contraction for every x, success would be a proof of the stronger sufficient C051 route, not evidence that C050 implies C051.
repair_candidate.analytic_falsifier: Construct a rational unit-diagonal SPD family A_n and rational vectors x_n for which [||x_n||_A^2-B_A(x_n)]/[mu_n||x_n||_A^2] tends to zero or is negative. The primary target is a large alternating component Alt_A=(1/n!)sum sign(pi)T_pi or another high random-transposition mode.
repair_candidate.next_exact_edge: Exploit the exact high-order alternant expansion, or another explicit nonstandard representation, to bound or refute the Fourier surplus at the mu scale without paying a second scalar factor n.

direct_C050_multiepoch_fallback.statement: For some universal fixed m_0 and 0<c_0<=1, the product-space mean-plus-sum-of-epoch-Dirichlet proxy B_A^(m_0) is at most (1-c_0 mu)||x||_A^2 for every A,x.
direct_C050_multiepoch_fallback.target_transfer: Tensorized Poincare plus fixed-block iteration gives C=exp(c_0/2) and c=c_0/(2m_0), including incomplete blocks.
direct_C050_multiepoch_fallback.relation_to_C051: Unlike the one-epoch proxy, a fixed m_0>1 statement need not imply C051 and targets C050 directly.
direct_C050_multiepoch_fallback.finite_control: At m_0=2, both n=3 rho=9/10 equicorrelation (36 sequences, 108 cases per slot) and an interacting signed n=4 Hadamard family (576 sequences, 3456 cases per slot, mu=3/20) pass exact principal-minor checks at c_0=1. The exact metric-map recursion extends the interacting-family control through m=4 without enumerating 24^m sequences.
direct_C050_multiepoch_fallback.exact_recursion: For H(Q)=E T^TQT, G(Q)=(n-1)E(T-T')^TQ(T-T')/4, and M=E T, B_A^(m)=(M^m)^T A M^m+sum_{ell=1}^m H^(ell-1)G(H^(m-ell)(A)).
direct_C050_multiepoch_fallback.open_objection: No general fixed m_0, c_0 inequality has been proved or numerically optimized beyond small controls.

decision.reason: The generating worker cannot independently hard-prune its own sealed route under the breadth/depth protocol. A different-run exact critic must reconstruct the witness.
decision.reopen_if: A different worker either (i) independently certifies the F1 witness and then develops the stated compensated repair, (ii) rejects F1 by exact arithmetic, (iii) proves/refutes the one-epoch proxy on a genuinely interacting all-dimensional family, or (iv) proves/refutes the fixed-multi-epoch direct-C050 proxy for a universal block length.
